cards.card_text: Now the governor's soldiers take Jesus into the Praetorium and gather the whole company around Him.
cards.verse_text: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company around Him.
cards.snippet: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company around Him.

cards.card_text: Then the soldiers lead Jesus away into the palace, the Praetorium.
cards.verse_text: Then the soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called the whole company together.
cards.snippet: Then the soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called the whole company together.

cards.card_text: It's early morning, and Jesus, under arrest, is led away from Caiaphas, the high priest that year (John 18:13), into the Praetorium, the Roman governor's headquarters.
cards.verse_text: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium.
cards.snippet: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium.

cards.card_text: The Jews won't step inside the Praetorium.
cards.verse_text: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium.
cards.snippet: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium.

cards.card_text: Pilate goes back into the Praetorium and calls for Jesus.
cards.verse_text: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
cards.snippet: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”

cards.card_text: He goes back into the Praetorium and asks Jesus, "Where are You from?"
cards.verse_text: When Pilate heard this statement, he was even more afraid, and he went back into the Praetorium.
cards.snippet: …statement, he was even more afraid, and he went back into the Praetorium.

cards.card_text: Until then, Paul is kept under guard in Herod's Praetorium.
cards.verse_text: he said, “I will hear your case when your accusers arrive.” Then he ordered that Paul be kept under guard in Herod’s Praetorium.
cards.snippet: …arrive.” Then he ordered that Paul be kept under guard in Herod’s Praetorium.
